name: The Endless Express
storyline:
Oh no, I fell asleep on the train… Where am I?

Explore some cool places by taking the train, get lost and find your way back home(?)! Talk and become friends with to the various characters on your voyage! Explore the various areas at different times and stuff!
summary:
The Endless Express is a game about traveling and discovery, and about how anything can become a magical and exciting experience with the right mindset.

This title was intended as the team's first commercial release, after making the original 2014 game jam version. They attempted to expand on the concept and try to put in all the ideas they initially conceived years prior, however the project ended up being a bit too big to properly finish at their current level of experience in 2016. The game was cancelled, and the current build of The Endless Express made available to the public.
